title: Oral question file
description: A file in oral/ is a JSON list of spoken oral questions. Write-a-query questions go in query/ (see query-question.schema.json). Checked by `npm run check` (server/oral/bank.js mirrors these rules).

id.description: Unique across oral/ and query/, always starting with 'oral-', e.g. 'oral-l02-q03'. Never reuse or rename an id.

type.description: explain: explain a concept. compare: X vs Y. walkthrough: explain what given code/query/system does. topic: talk freely for several minutes.

topic.description: Exactly one of the lecture names in course.json.

prompt.description: What the examiner asks. Sub-questions go on their own lines as 'a) …', 'b) …'.

code.description: Optional code, schema or data shown in a monospace block (\n for new lines).

hints.description: Revealed one at a time, each more specific than the last. The last hint still must not give the full answer away.

keyPoints.description: What a complete answer must mention, one point each. Used as the self-check list and as the grading rubric.

modelAnswer.description: A strong answer as you would say it at the exam.

followUps.description: Questions an examiner would ask next.

seconds.description: Suggested answer time. Defaults to oral.timerSeconds in course.json.

source.description: Where it comes from, e.g. 'Lecture 3, slides 10-14; H25 Assignment 2, Q3'.

coverage.description: slides (default) if taught, pensum if only in the reading list.
